_doc: Prompts for this channel's music library (Drive Music-Library/practical/). Generate with scripts/lyria_music.py; PLAYBOOK §11.1.
common: Instrumental only: no vocals, no choir, no humming, no spoken words, no vocal samples, and no pads or synths that sound like voices or a choir: sustained sounds come from bowed strings, piano, electric piano, organ-free analogue synths and electronic hum. This is a documentary underscore that plays under a narrator's voice: no lead melody in the speech range, no sudden loud hits or long silences, a steady overall level from start to finish, clean cinematic mix, wide stereo. Make it about three minutes long. It ends with a final held chord or note that decays naturally, never an abrupt cut.

tracks.title: Investigation
tracks.use: Act 1 of an investigative documentary: following the trail
tracks.prompt: Investigative and curious. 90 BPM, E minor. A muted electric bass line with a gentle groove, soft brushed drums, light plucked guitar or muted synth stabs, a low pad. Like following a paper trail through an office at night. Steady, engaging, never loud.
tracks.brief: investigative curious bassline, soft groove, steady

tracks.title: Shutdown
tracks.use: Tension: a crisis, plants shutting, a dependency exposed
tracks.prompt: Sparse and tense. 70 BPM, C minor. A deep analogue synth bass pulse on every beat, low held cello notes, a quiet ticking hi-hat, sparse low piano notes and faint metallic textures. Dark and quiet with a steady level, the stakes are high.
tracks.brief: sparse tense dark synth bass pulse, low cello, ticking, quiet steady level

tracks.title: How It Works
tracks.use: Explainers: how a system works, how money flows
tracks.prompt: Curious and friendly. 100 BPM, G major. Pizzicato strings and marimba in a light bouncing pattern, a soft piano, a gentle shaker. Bright, clear and intelligent, like an engineer explaining over coffee. Low and unobtrusive.
tracks.brief: curious friendly pizzicato and marimba, light, unobtrusive

tracks.title: A Way Forward
tracks.use: The practical defence, the action plan, hope
tracks.prompt: Warm and hopeful. 84 BPM, C major. Gentle piano chords, warm strings, a soft acoustic guitar pattern, a light pulse. Encouraging and calm, like a friend telling you it can be fixed.
tracks.brief: warm hopeful piano and strings, encouraging, calm

tracks.title: Counter-offensive
tracks.use: India fights back: rising effort, new plants, the comeback
tracks.prompt: Determined and rising. 112 BPM, D minor. Cinematic percussion with dhol and tabla blended into orchestral drums, driving low strings, brass swells. Builds from a quiet beginning to a strong confident peak, then settles.
tracks.brief: determined rising percussion, dhol and tabla, driving strings, builds

tracks.title: Made in India
tracks.use: India's capability: a launch, an engine, a chip; the proud reveal
tracks.prompt: Proud and uplifting. 86 BPM, D major. Broad cinematic strings, a bansuri phrase in the middle, warm French horns, soft timpani. Proud but not jingoistic, emotional and confident, resolving warmly.
tracks.brief: proud uplifting cinematic strings, bansuri, warm, not jingoistic

tracks.title: The Trap
tracks.use: Scams, traps, fraud calls, the danger the viewer must see
tracks.prompt: Uneasy suspense. 80 BPM, F minor. A dark pulsing synth, unsettling high sustained notes, a slow low piano motif, soft ticking. The feeling that something is wrong on the other end of a phone call. Tense but restrained.
tracks.brief: uneasy suspense, dark pulse, ticking, restrained

tracks.title: Money Talk
tracks.use: Money and rights explainers: bills, salaries, loans, rules
tracks.prompt: Light, modern and neutral. 95 BPM, A major. A soft brushed drum groove, warm electric piano chords, a round electric bass, light acoustic guitar plucks. No samples, no vocal chops. Friendly and calm, sits well under a voice explaining something practical.
tracks.brief: light modern calm groove, electric piano, bass, guitar plucks

tracks.title: Silicon
tracks.use: Technology, AI, chips, data centres, the future
tracks.prompt: Futuristic but warm. 106 BPM, B minor. Pulsing synth arpeggios, a deep bass, a clean modern beat, airy pads, digital textures. Smart and forward-looking.
tracks.brief: futuristic warm synth arpeggios, modern beat, forward-looking

tracks.title: A Family's Story
tracks.use: Human stories: a family, a worker, a patient, the cost to a person
tracks.prompt: Emotional and intimate. 66 BPM, A minor. Solo piano, soft cello, a light warm pad. Tender and human, a story about one family. No percussion.
tracks.brief: emotional intimate solo piano and cello, no percussion

tracks.title: Stay Practical
tracks.prompt: Warm and confident closing. 88 BPM, G major. A gentle groove with soft drums, warm piano and strings, a hint of tabla. Friendly and resolved, ends on a held major chord.
tracks.brief: warm confident closing, gentle groove, resolved

tracks.title: Shorts Bed
tracks.use: Vertical Shorts: a quick fact or trap
tracks.prompt: Make this one about one minute long. Starts immediately with no intro: a punchy curious beat, deep bass, plucked synth and a tabla accent, 115 BPM, E minor. A small lift at thirty seconds, ends on a held note.
tracks.brief: punchy curious immediate start, about one minute
